definitions.explanation: A state of disagreement or conflict between people, especially within a family, couple, or organization. Composed of 不 (not) + 和 (harmony). Implies an ongoing state of tension rather than a single argument.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不和|ふわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不和|ふわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved because of family discord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不和|ふわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: We set up a forum for discussion to resolve the internal discord.

notes:
USAGE:
{不和|ふわ} describes a sustained state of conflict or lack of harmony between people. It is more formal and serious than ⟦{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い→仲が悪い：25621_nakagawarui⟧ (to be on bad terms), which is more conversational.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{不和|ふわ} (marital discord)
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧{不和|ふわ} (family discord)
- {不和|ふわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧ (discord arises)
- {不和|ふわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧ (to invite discord)
- {不和|ふわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ (to resolve discord)
